BStore_StubTable slot `calr sub_F6306A / ret` behind T_F427EC. sub_F6306A copies the chain bytes from the cursor (block DE, offset (0x0C6B)) up to the source end
(block (0x0C61), offset (0x0C67)) so they end at the destination end ((0x0C57)/(0x0C5D)), back to front with LDDR, following the blocks' +1 back links. BStore_AppendBytes and StepRecord_BStoreAppendBytes use it to open the gap the new bytes are then copied into. Basis: callers + body (target read).

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:157919 `calr sub_F6B50C` -- ... then sub_F6B50C ldir-copies the source bytes (0x1272) in at the cursor (0x3460/0x3482)

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142290 `calr BStore_SeekBlock` -- sub_F6306A: source block (0x0C61) located ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142294 `calr BStore_SeekBlock` -- ... destination block (0x0C57) located

Sends one 2C reply of a third-region request: sub_F37DB4 builds F0 50 2C 04 00 11 + the address septets of (0x0A03) + count (0x0A09) at 0x0A0B, then the bytes at 0x0B0B as nibble pairs
(one byte from 0x0B0B/0x0B0C when (0x0A00) bit 8/9), 00, SysEx_Checksum, F7, SysExTx_SendBytes; (0x0A07) -= n, (0x0A03) += n; re-arms (0x0A00) bit 2 while bytes remain, else (0x0A00) := 0. Basis: callers + body + sysex_third_region.py.

Every pass latches TransportB_State into (0x345A) and clears its bits 1 and 4 (the just-started / STOPPED marks MIDI_RT_Received writes as 0x06 / 0x10) under DI; only with record tracks armed
((0x3000) != 0) does it act on them: (0x3004) set + STOPPED edge -> sub_F45348, else started edge -> note-routing rebuild + sub_F44ADA; ends with sub_F44A3B. One step of Seq_MainLoopService. Basis: caller + body + state-bit layout.
basis: caller + body + the prom_a transport state-bit header

prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:68790 `ld (TransportB_State:8), 0x10:io` -- stop -> 0x10, STOPPED (prom_a header "THIS ROUTINE DEFINES THE TRANSPORT STATE BYTES")
